T: Roast beast. Who pudding. No stealing.
D: A grumpy green hermit plans to steal Christmas from the cheerful town below his mountain.
P: Serve the roast beast when the Whos sit down to their Christmas feast.
S: Green marshmallow corn flake wreaths with red candy berries
Cornflakes stirred through melted marshmallow and butter tinted green, shaped into little wreaths, red lollies pressed on as berries.
Cob loaf cut and stuffed with garlic butter, mozzarella and cheddar

A crusty cob sliced in a criss-cross and stuffed with mozzarella, cheddar and garlic herb butter, baked into a molten peak to pull apart. Heat the oven to 180C. Cut a round cob loaf in a criss-cross pattern, not quite through the base. Melt 80g butter with 2 crushed garlic cloves, parsley and chives. Push 150g grated mozzarella and 100g grated cheddar into the cuts and drizzle over the butter. Wrap in foil and bake 15 minutes, then unwrap and bake 10 more until bubbling and golden.
M: Beef rib roast, roast potatoes, Yorkshire puddings and gravy
Beef rib roast seasoned overnight, roasted at 220C for 20 minutes then 160C to 52C, rested, carved at the table with Yorkshire puddings, roast potatoes and gravy.
Cindy Lou's Who-hash with fried eggs
corned beef and potato crisped in butter, runny eggs, before his heart grows three sizes

Corned beef, potato and onion fried hard in butter until crusty, topped with runny fried eggs, pickled jalapeño and a tangy green herb sauce. Boil 800g diced potatoes for 6 minutes and drain. Fry 1 diced onion in 40g butter, add the potatoes and fry for 10 minutes, pressing down. Add 400g diced corned beef and fry until crusty, turning in sections. Blend parsley, chives, 1 garlic clove, lemon and 80ml oil for sauce. Fry 4 eggs. Serve the hash with eggs, sauce and pickled jalapeño.
W: Fruit loaf baked in a vanilla egg custard until puffed and golden
Bread and butter pudding made with fruit loaf, layered in a dish, soaked in a vanilla custard of eggs, milk and cream, baked at 170C for 40 minutes.
K: Lime sorbet, lemonade and pineapple juice in a frothy green punch, no alcohol
Lime sorbet scooped into a punch bowl, topped with lemonade and pineapple juice so it froths up green.

Roast at 220C, then drop to 160C until 52C inside.
Rest the beef under foil.
Roast the potatoes in oil.

steps.text: Fry the mushrooms, onion and garlic in the butter until dry and dark, stir in the walnuts, spinach, salt and pepper and cool.
Overlap the pastry sheets, spoon the mushroom mix along the middle, roll up, seal the ends and brush with one beaten egg.
Roast the potatoes in the olive oil at 220C.
Bake the wellington at 200C until deep golden.
Whisk the remaining eggs, milk and the flour for the batter and bake in hot oiled tins at 220C.
Whisk the gravy flour into the stock and soy sauce and simmer until thick.
Heat the oven to 170C. Layer the buttered fruit loaf in a dish.
Whisk the eggs, milk, cream, sugar and vanilla and pour over.
Rest.
Bake until puffed and golden.

s.note: Green marshmallow corn flake wreaths with red candy berries
s.how: Melt 50g butter with 200g marshmallows and a few drops of green colouring. Stir through 120g corn flakes until coated. Shape spoonfuls into little wreaths on baking paper and press on red lollies as berries. Set for an hour.

s.note: Cob loaf cut and stuffed with garlic butter, mozzarella and cheddar
s.how: Heat the oven to 180C. Cut a round cob loaf in a criss-cross pattern, not quite through the base. Melt 80g butter with 2 crushed garlic cloves, parsley and chives. Push 150g grated mozzarella and 100g grated cheddar into the cuts and drizzle over the butter. Wrap in foil and bake 15 minutes, then unwrap and bake 10 more until bubbling and golden.

m.note: Beef rib roast, roast potatoes, Yorkshire puddings and gravy
m.how: Season a 2kg beef rib roast overnight. Roast at 220C for 20 minutes then 160C to 52C inside and rest. Roast 1kg potatoes. Whisk 3 eggs, 150g flour and 300ml milk and bake in hot oiled tins at 220C for 20 minutes. Make gravy with 400ml stock.

w.note: Fruit loaf baked in a vanilla egg custard until puffed and golden
w.how: Butter 8 slices fruit loaf and layer in a dish. Whisk 4 eggs, 400ml milk, 200ml cream, 60g sugar and vanilla and pour over. Rest 20 minutes, then bake at 170C for 40 minutes until puffed and golden.

d.note: Lime sorbet, lemonade and pineapple juice in a frothy green punch, no alcohol
d.how: Scoop 500ml lime sorbet into a punch bowl. Pour over 1L lemonade and 250ml pineapple juice so it froths up green. Add lime slices and ladle into cups.
